guard/32177.htm.text: Marksman Syzar: You're an adventurer, eh? And you're trying to leave this way? He he... you must have some skill, then... This way lies Mimir's Forest , home to some of the most dangerous monsters on the island. You realize that, don't you?

guard/32177-1.htm.text: Marksman Syzar: Mimir's Forest leads to Nornil's Cave. According to legend, it was named after Mimir, the great Giant who planted the Seed of Creation.
